items.title: The Plastic Man Comedy Adventure Show (1979 to 1981)
items.description: The Plastic Man Comedy/Adventure Show is an animated television series produced by Ruby-Spears Productions from 1979 to 1981, it was shown right after Super Friends on the ABC Network. The show featured various adventures of the DC Comics superhero Plastic Man
